items.title: Shared Chat controls
items.summary: Exact meaning and authorisation state of the 'Ask for Approval' control; final semantic assignments of the four top-right controls; further conversation-type conversion directions beyond Temporary->Normal/Temporary->Multi-Agent/Normal->Multi-Agent; Temporary chat permission to read existing authorised memories and precise end-of-session retention UX.

items.title: Multi-Agent Chat
items.summary: Participant selection, automatic orchestration and turn-taking policy, and whether humans may participate. Distinguish from Assistant Teams and Chat Group/Project containers.

items.title: Usage limits
items.summary: Explicit forecast confidence and urgency threshold for automatic 'about to block' pin override. Two differently coloured usage/context measures in one compact progress circle required; exact geometry is a visual refinement.

items.title: Tasks
items.summary: Badge precedence among simultaneous Permission Needed, Stalled, Working and unread Checkpoint except confirmed Blocked-over-Checkpoint rule; precise viewed/acknowledged checkpoint definition and device synchronisation; sorting tie-breaks and manual pin override; priority control placement.

items.title: Assistants and Teams
items.summary: Whether Main may be visibly renamed while keeping permanent Main role; handoff confirmation/branching details; permanent Team conversation organisation beyond main group chat; member roster editing/conflict policy; default coordination mode; leader absence/fallback and contested delegation; default All/Relevant/None coordination-chat visibility.

items.title: Universal Steer/Queue
items.summary: Initial fallback default outside Research when a Space has no saved preference; handling queued follow-up work that becomes ineligible after scope or policy changes.

items.title: Shopping
items.summary: Product-versus-offer grouping and user-toggle behaviour; supported merchant/provider integrations; optional price-watch/alert sourcing and display; recommendation disclosure and advanced sorter defaults.

items.title: Shared response/composer controls
items.summary: Default reaction-triggered AI reply behaviour; report-context preview; per-Space toolbar/blacklist override precedence; display-name Automation validation UX; Plugin timeout/permission presets and policy restrictions; canonical rich-message storage syntax/version.

items.title: Dulche context/safety deployment
items.summary: UCML schema/version and secure key-rotation deployment details; provenance presentation; policy-grounded escalation and appeal thresholds.

items.title: Peer Review initial delegated-power checkboxes
items.summary: Initial defaults for Pause/Resume/Restart Work, interventionary work, Restart Worker, Reset Worker Context, Change Worker Model, Stop/Quarantine Workers and peer approval option for risky calls.

items.title: Custom Space Builder
items.summary: Initial starter template; resolution UX when Basic/Advanced setting collides with complex Expert graph behaviour. Three views must preserve one canonical Space.

items.title: Study
items.summary: Evidence weighting, confidence thresholds and review intervals; source-policy defaults; per-platform performance budgets; subject topic-tree editing and specialised maths/code/essay question-widget details.

items.title: Shared layout refinements
items.summary: Chat Group/Project list composition; type-selector/Tab View/voice pill/Summary arrangements; Action Graph shortcut location; Assistant navigation structure; Research panel/tile geometry.
